chapter: Team Magma Space Center invasion (hangar, support room)
cap_confirmation: driver state reported level_cap 84; all four members at offset 1 = L83 = cap + offset - 2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Same raid party and audit as E0401: Mind Badge earned, before the Seafloor Cavern; no pool-84 addition used. Landorus is the one reachable legend.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Prankster Reflect / Light Screen before the first attack
Skarmory Sturdy + Iron Defense + Body Press

attempts.party: party_raid84.json (Incineroar / Urshifu-Rapid / Mega Swampert / Great Tusk / Landorus / Gholdengo)
attempts.why: Turn 1 Fake Out flinched Klefki's Reflect, Aerodactyl set Tailwind, Surging Strikes killed Aerodactyl. Turn 2 Reflect went up under Tailwind, Skarmory Iron Defense, Surging Strikes + Flare Blitz took Skarmory to 113 at the cost of three Rocky Helmet hits on Urshifu (144 lost). Turn 3 I pulled Urshifu for Gholdengo; Skarmory's +2 Body Press one-shot Incineroar (256) before Flare Blitz - faint one. Turn 4 Landorus in, Light Screen went up, Earth Power killed Klefki, Gholdengo Nasty Plot, Tailwind ended. Turn 5 Obstagoon Obstructed Earth Power, +2 Shadow Ball killed Skarmory through Light Screen, Flame Orb burned Obstagoon. Turn 6 Guts Knock Off one-shot Gholdengo (319) - faint two - while Earth Power took Obstagoon to 58. Turn 7 Earth Power finished it. A real fight: the screens, the Rocky Helmet tax and the Guts Knock Off all did what the plan says.

strategy_checks.evidence: Reflect turn 2 (turn-1 attempt flinched by Fake Out), Light Screen turn 4; both changed damage rolls (Flare Blitz on Skarmory, Shadow Ball 147 not ~220)
turn 1 'A tailwind started blowing'; petered out end of turn 4; no Berry of mine was in a position to activate so Unnerve was not tested
turn 2 Iron Defense, turn 3 +2 Body Press 256 one-shot on Incineroar
turn 5 Obstruct blocked Earth Power and Flame Orb burned it; turn 6 Guts Knock Off 319 one-shot Gholdengo

protect_ledger.payoff: Obstruct blocked a ~90 Earth Power (real) and let Flame Orb activate before it attacked

protect_summary: 1 Obstruct with real payoff. Aerodactyl held Protect and chose Tailwind instead; fine.
ai_notes: Klefki's Thunder Wave was never chosen into two Dark/Good-as-Gold slots, which is correct. Skarmory's Body Press targeting the Dark-type Incineroar rather than the Fighting-resistant slot was right. Obstagoon Knock Off on the Ghost/Steel Gholdengo was the best move on the board.
level_change_rationale: Won with 2 faints after a real fight; brief step 5 says keep.
cooler: This is the raid's best room and it plays like the plan reads: screens, Tailwind, a Body Press wall and a Guts closer. The Berry-denial hook could not be felt because my party had no Berry that mattered by then. Keep as is; if anything, Klefki's fourth move could be Foul Play so it threatens something after its two screens are up.
verification_limit: No level change, nothing pending re-verification.
